svg.title: Flow chart of coming down from a stimulant: the stimulant increases dopamine binding to receptors (the “high”); a compensatory response blocks natural synthesis of dopamine; on coming down (withdrawal, the “low”), natural dopamine release is decreased for over a week; this gives a longer-term loss of motivation and attention. A brace under the chain notes that with extended use the “high” weakens but the “low” strengthens.
